cases.translation: The Lord speaks to his anointed one, Cyrus.
cases.explain: Господь is the subject of the verb "говорит", so nominative case.

cases.translation: I hold him by his right hand.
cases.explain: Рука is the direct object after the preposition "за", so accusative case.
Народ is the direct object of the transitive verb "смирить", so accusative.

cases.translation: I will break the bronze doors in pieces.
cases.explain: Ворота is the direct object of the transitive verb "разломаю", so accusative.
The preposition "в" (in) governs the prepositional case for location.

cases.translation: I will level mountains in the work of the Lord.
cases.explain: After the preposition "в деле" (in the work of), genitive is used to show possession.

cases.translation: I will give you treasures of darkness.
cases.explain: After the noun "сокровища" (treasures), genitive shows possession or origin.

cases.translation: I, the Lord, create all things.
cases.explain: Всё is the direct object of the transitive verb "создаю", so accusative.

reading.question: What does God declare about His uniqueness?
options: God says He is alone and there is no other
God says He forgives all people
God says He is merciful to all
reading.correct: God says He is alone and there is no other
reading.explain: "Я Господь, и другого нет" — I am the Lord, and there is no other.

reading.ru: Я создаю свет и творю тьму, даю благополучие и творю беду.
reading.question: What does God say He creates?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states God creates both light and darkness, both prosperity and calamity.

reading.ru: Горе тому, кто припирается со своим Создателем.
reading.question: Who does God say faces judgment?
options: Those who argue with their Creator
reading.correct: Those who argue with their Creator
reading.explain: "Горе тому" (woe to the one) who contends with his Maker.

reading.ru: Обратитесь ко мне и будете спасены все края земли.
reading.question: What promise does God make?
options: All the ends of the earth shall be saved
Only the righteous will be saved
reading.correct: All the ends of the earth shall be saved
reading.explain: The text states those who turn to God shall be saved—all the ends of the earth.

reading.ru: Я поклялся самим собой, в праведности из уст моих вышло слово.
reading.question: By what does God swear?
reading.explain: The text says "я поклялся самим собой" — I have sworn by myself.

reading.ru: Преклонится предо мной каждое колено, мною будет клясться каждый язык.
reading.question: What will all peoples do before God?
options: Every knee will bow and every tongue will swear by Him
Every ear will hear His voice
reading.correct: Every knee will bow and every tongue will swear by Him
reading.explain: The text declares "преклонится...каждое колено...мною будет клясться каждый язык".
